seoTitle: AI Content Idea Generator for Creators
seoDescription: Never stare at a blank upload schedule again. Get 10 specific, ready-to-film content ideas for any niche in seconds — free AI skill for creators.
long_description: Coming up with good ideas is the hardest part of being a creator — and the most time-consuming. This skill turns Claude or ChatGPT into your personal content strategist, generating 10 distinct, ready-to-film ideas for any niche you throw at it. Each idea comes with a working title, the angle that makes it interesting, and why it's likely to perform. The ideas span the full mix: evergreen tutorials, trending formats, personal stories, hot takes, behind-the-scenes, and educational deep dives. Give it your niche and walk away with a week's worth of content.
author: CreatorSkills
